guide.com_legal: Grenazerker skill pool is ONLY Sinergia, Arriba, Abajo, Confeti — never Booming Business or El Paraguas. Splash Damage is a passive roll; Gadget Ahoy is firmware.
guide.repkit_bonus_help: Legendary kits get Heart Pump/3-charge as the legendary perk plus ONE secondary. Ranked for Peacebreaker + Waterfall:
guide.experimental_mags: Experimental magnitudes (community scrape, name_inferred) — not confirmed / not for leaderboards.
guide.how_body: Peacebreaker Cannons keep Overdrive up so fire rate, reload, and gun damage stay high. Crits from Booming Business and El Paraguas spawn extra grenades; splash crits feed the same loop. Confeti Protocol + Beam Team and a Grenazerker COM (Sinergia/Confeti) push ordnance and splash. Now With Caffeine + Triple Bypass maximizes action-skill uptime. Skills/specs stay fixed (respec costs money) — swap the full free gear loadout per content type: mobbing, bossing, or balanced.
guide.legendaries_help: Farm these exact search names. Prefer Maliwan Mixologist enhancement so inactive elements snapshot into Peacebreaker.
guide.repkit_math: Now With Caffeine removes 25% of max action-skill cooldown per repkit activation. Uptime = duration ÷ (duration + cooldown × leftover). Using D=20s Peacebreaker / C=40s cooldown: 0 charges → 33.3%; 1-charge legendaries → 40%; Triple Bypass (3 charges) → 66.7% with 25% CD left after one dump. Heart Pump (30% charge on kill) raises effective uptime further while mobbing.
guide.repkit_rolls: Want on TripleBypass: Heart Pump + Accelerator (mobbing/balanced) or Amp (bossing burst). Keep Now With Caffeine equipped — without it, charge count does not cut action-skill CD.
guide.swap_chart_help: Keep skills/specs. Swap the whole gear set — gear is free to change; respec is not.
guide.stack_totals_help: Additive experimental totals from skills + firmware + synergies + COM + every equipped gear piece + dual enhancement perks for the active content type.
guide.dual_enh_help: Legendary enhancements roll two perks. Ranked same-manufacturer pairs for this content type.
